Docket 1.3.92

**Four findings that asked professional-services sites for things they should not add.**

- *"Incomplete Offer markup … missing price" for a list of your services.* An
  offer of a service in your catalogue feeds no rich result, and a free
  consultation has no price. Offers of services are no longer checked for one;
  offers of products still are.
- *"Incomplete Product markup … missing image" for markup carrying reviews.*
  Google's product snippet needs a name and a review, rating or offer — the
  image is required when something is for sale. A product with a rating and no
  offer is no longer asked for one.
- *"Phone links … it is asking for visitors dialling from outside" because a
  site has a Spanish version.* Language tags name languages, not countries.
  The stronger wording is kept for sites whose language tags name more than
  one country; a second language alone gets a gentler note.
- *"Titles repeat the same keyword excessively" because of your own name.* A
  business name that contains a word twice, used at the start and again at the
  end of a title, is your name twice — not keyword stuffing. Real repetition is
  still reported.

99 checks across 13 areas.
